title: One pass = one command: render + check + side/blend/edges/crops + region means
summary: Each pass: render with CHECK, then side-by-side, 50/50 blend, reference edges over the render, stacked same-region crops and mean sRGB of 12 regions. The numbers catch grade errors first.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: docs/style-studio-critic-loop: still.mjs (CHECK=1), overlay.ps1, tunnel/pass.ps1, crop.ps1, regions.ps1

doc.when: Every pass of a reference-matching loop.
gotchas: Read a stacked crop as top = ref, bottom = render at y + h (an agent once 'saw' the tunnel 350 px too low).
Region means found earth nearly black-orange (24,13,4 vs 46,36,29) and figures yellow (G/R .7 vs .46) when the eye said 'a bit dark'.

problem.symptom: Grade and colour errors survive several passes; misread crops.
problem.fix: A fixed overlay pack per pass with machine-readable numbers next to the images.
problem.detect: No region numbers in the pass log.
